query: Set up GitHub Actions CI for this package.
expected_behavior: Puts the suite behind one local command (Makefile target or script) that CI only calls
Pins actions to a commit SHA and the toolchain version in one place both laptop and CI read
Sets default permissions to none and grants only contents: read
Cancels superseded runs on PRs only, not on main

query: Write a script that releases this package to PyPI.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/releases.md and reference/publishing.md before writing
Separates build (no secrets) from publish, and publishes the exact bytes it built and tested
Resolves remote main to a SHA and releases that frozen commit; never tags from the local checkout
Writes a manifest with a checksum per file and asserts the built set equals an explicit expected list
Asserts preconditions before upload (version is new or a partial publish of the same bytes, CI passed) and skips steps already done
Stops and asks before the first upload, and prefers trusted publishing (OIDC) over a long-lived token
Verifies from the public registry after publishing

query: We want to rename the `attempts` parameter to `max_attempts` and ship it in the next release. Make the change and prepare the release.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/compatibility.md and reference/releases.md before acting
Identifies the rename as a contract break for callers of the last release
Prefers deprecation: keeps `attempts` working with a warning for at least one release, or explains why not
If the break is declared, requires a breaking changelog entry with a migration note and a major bump
Stops and asks before declaring a break or publishing; does not publish or tag on its own
